description: An HTML file implementing the user interface for a web-based database viewer application, including styling, layout, and client-side scripting for interacting with backend APIs to browse databases and display table data.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the backend API and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list by reloading all available databases and resetting UI state.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the database in the sidebar and loads its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches tables for a specific database and displays them in the sidebar.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads and renders data for a selected table, including handling large content and object expansion.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders table data into an HTML table element, managing wide content and providing scroll hints.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates HTML for a cell, handling nulls, objects, and long text with expandability.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content when clicked to show full data.
